fields.summary_ko.0: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) fell 6.4% on November 16, and the Nasdaq index fell 2.2%, with chip stocks undergoing broad adjustment.
fields.summary_ko.1: MRVL announced a $115 billion convertible stock transaction to acquire Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE), and stock price continues to face pressure due to concerns over shareholder dilution.
